messages:
Sam (CS): Quick weekly check for IgniteCo — focusing on caching + batching metrics after we enabled prefetch cohort B last Tuesday. TL;DR: hit rate up, cost down, but saw an error spike during an afternoon burst.

Maria (CSE): numbers?

Sam (CS): last 7d vs prior 7d: cache hit rate 48% -> 71%; avg batch size 2.1 -> 3.9; cost per 1k tokens $2.12 -> $1.35. Prefetch cohort B = ~40% of traffic.

Aj Patel: nice. where did the errors surface?

Sam (CS): around 2026-03-10 10:30-10:45 UTC we saw 5xx spike to 2.3% (baseline ~0.15%). Correlated with a traffic burst of long-context requests (avg seq len ~1.8k tokens) and batches >8.

Ethan (Eng): logs show OOMs on the dedicated pool. Example log snippet: ```ERROR: OOM while allocating KV cache size=1.2G model=redwood-ggml-v2 batch=12``` Root cause looks like large batches + big KV allocations for long contexts.

Maria (CSE): customer reported timeouts during onboarding demo — they hit the tail latency.

Lina (PM): renewal touchpoint end of Q2. Health overall positive but latency incidents are a flag. Recommend calling out risk as Low->Medium unless we stabilize tail latency.

Sam (CS): Agreed. Proposed action items: 1) cap batch size at 8 for cohort B; 2) reduce KV cache TTL for long-context queries to 120s; 3) enable adaptive-batching fallback to smaller batches during spikes; 4) run cost re-estimate for next invoice.

Aj Patel: I'll open a canary patch to the Dedicated config and monitor. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/dedicated-config/pull/582

OpsBot: Deploy scheduled: canary -> prod if error rate < 0.5% over 4h.

Ethan (Eng): sample config I plan to apply on canary:
```
batching: {
  max_batch: 8,
  long_context_threshold: 1024,
  adaptive: true
}
cache: {
  kv_ttl: 120,
  strategy: "prefix"
}
```

Maria (CSE): I'll draft a short note for the IgniteCo CSM and offer a 1:1 onboarding session to walk through the demo issues (offer times: Tue/Wed next week).

Sam (CS): If canary is good, expected outcome: cost per 1k tokens stabilizes near $1.4 and p95 tail latency < 400ms.

Lina (PM): owners + due dates?

Sam (CS): Aj -> canary patch today; Ethan -> monitor + rollback plan; Maria -> customer comm by EOD; Lina -> send renewal follow-up next Tue.

Maria (CSE): :thumbsup:

Aj Patel: on it, will ping when canary is up.

Sam (CS): Thanks all — I'll post a short recap to the account doc and include the cost delta and incident timeline.
